description: This file defines the UserController class within the Conduit.Features.Users namespace. The class handles user-related HTTP requests such as retrieving current user details and updating user information, using MediatR for command/query handling and ASP.NET Core MVC attributes for routing and authorization.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: MVC Controller for user operations, including fetching current user details and updating user info.

methods.name: GetCurrent
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch details of the current authenticated user.

methods.name: UpdateUser
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update the current user's information.
